title: Rockbridge depth-6 inter-entity ledger status
summary: Primary disclosures establish paid personnel overlap, while beneficial ownership and exact inter-entity transfers remain unresolved.

sources.title: Hannah Huemme OGE Form 278e
sources.publisher: The White House / U.S. Office of Government Ethics

sources.title: Tech donor network co-founded by JD Vance seeks to push America to the right

resolved: Hannah Huemme simultaneously reported development roles at Better Tomorrow and Rockbridge Network LLC from January 2022 through February 2025.
Her OGE filing reports $162,048 from Better Tomorrow and $19,500 from Rockbridge Network LLC.
Better Tomorrow's 2024 Form 990 index reports Schedule L conflict-of-interest transactions and $7,036,257 revenue.
unresolved: Rockbridge Network LLC beneficial owners and managers
Schedule L counterparties and transaction amounts
Direct payments among Rockbridge LLC, Better Tomorrow, Over The Horizon Action, Faithful in Action, Firebrand Action and Turnout for America
Shared vendors, compliance firms and bank accounts
value.interpretation: The public record supports operational/personnel overlap but does not establish consolidated ownership or a complete money-flow ledger.

data.method: Primary OGE disclosure extraction plus Form 990 and reporting review

gaps: Schedule L XML/PDF counterpart details and Delaware ownership records remain required.
